Poké-Power: Sheet Lightning — Once during your turn, when you put Zapdos from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.
[Lightning][Lightning][Colorless] Raging Thunder 80 — Does 40 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.
